The '''''Gallant''''' was a [[Majestic-class heavy cruiser|''Majestic''-class heavy cruiser]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]] where it would partake in the [[Battle of Doornik-319]].
